script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(k.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', k.job_status, 'correlation_id', k.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', k.progress_percent, 'progress_message', k.progress_message,
                   'error_code', k.error_code, 'error_message', k.error_message, 'line_count', k.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'sa_no', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.saNo')), NULL),
                   'sc_id', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND k.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.key}}'
           AND k.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS sa_id, g.adjustment_no, g.stock_adjustment_status, g.organization_id,
       CAST(g.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, CAST(g.adjustment_no_type AS CHAR) AS no_type, CAST(g.stock_count_id AS CHAR) AS stock_count_id,
       CAST(g.sa_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS sa_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('step', p.step_name, 'ref', p.result_ref,
                            'young', (p.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 120 SECOND),
                            'job', (SELECT q.job_status FROM gd_async_job q
                                     WHERE q.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND q.idempotency_key = p.result_ref AND q.is_deleted = 0
                                     ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}} > 0
           AND p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'SAC|{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS sa_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', o.job_status, 'correlation_id', o.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', o.progress_percent, 'progress_message', o.progress_message,
                   'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message, 'line_count', o.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'sa_no', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.saNo')), NULL),
                   'sc_id', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL))) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}} > 0
           AND o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.command = 'COMPLETE_SA'
           AND o.correlation_id = 'SA|{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}}'
           AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_SA', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', x.job_status, 'correlation_id', x.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', x.progress_percent, 'progress_message', x.progress_message,
                   'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message, 'line_count', x.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'sa_no', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.saNo')), NULL),
                   'sc_id', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}} > 0
           AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command = 'COMPLETE_SA'
           AND x.correlation_id = 'SA|{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}}'
         ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(y.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', y.job_status, 'correlation_id', y.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', y.progress_percent, 'progress_message', y.progress_message,
                   'error_code', y.error_code, 'error_message', y.error_message, 'line_count', y.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'sa_no', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.saNo')), NULL),
                   'sc_id', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job y
         WHERE y.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND y.is_deleted = 0 AND y.command = 'COMPLETE_SA'
           AND y.id = CAST(g.sa_v2_job_id AS UNSIGNED)) AS link_job,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM gd_async_job r
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}} > 0
           AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.command = 'COMPLETE_SA'
           AND r.correlation_id = 'SA|{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}}'
           AND JSON_VALID(r.request_payload) AND COALESCE(g.adjustment_no, '') <> ''
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.request_payload, '$.issuedNo')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = g.adjustment_no) AS issued_reuse,
       CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS sc_id, c.stock_count_status, c.review_status AS sc_review_status, c.organization_id AS sc_organization_id,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(a.id AS CHAR), 'no', a.adjustment_no, 'job', CAST(a.sa_v2_job_id AS CHAR)) AS CHAR)
          FROM stock_adjustment a
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}} > 0
           AND a.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND a.stock_count_id = {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}}
           AND a.stock_adjustment_status = 'Processing' AND a.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS sc_processing_sa,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(so.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', so.job_status, 'correlation_id', so.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', so.progress_percent, 'progress_message', so.progress_message,
                   'error_code', so.error_code, 'error_message', so.error_message, 'line_count', so.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(so.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(so.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'sa_no', IF(JSON_VALID(so.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(so.request_payload, '$.saNo')), NULL),
                   'sc_id', IF(JSON_VALID(so.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(so.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL))) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job so
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}} > 0
           AND so.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND so.is_deleted = 0 AND so.command = 'COMPLETE_SA'
           AND so.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_SA', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
           AND JSON_VALID(so.request_payload)
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(so.request_payload, '$.scId')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}}') AS sc_open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(sl.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', sl.job_status, 'correlation_id', sl.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', sl.progress_percent, 'progress_message', sl.progress_message,
                   'error_code', sl.error_code, 'error_message', sl.error_message, 'line_count', sl.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(sl.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sl.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'sa_no', IF(JSON_VALID(sl.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sl.request_payload, '$.saNo')), NULL),
                   'sc_id', IF(JSON_VALID(sl.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sl.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job sl
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}} > 0
           AND sl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND sl.is_deleted = 0 AND sl.command = 'COMPLETE_SA'
           AND JSON_VALID(sl.request_payload)
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sl.request_payload, '$.scId')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}}'
         ORDER BY sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS sc_last_job,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('step', p.step_name, 'ref', p.result_ref,
                            'young', (p.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 120 SECOND),
                            'job', (SELECT q.job_status FROM gd_async_job q
                                     WHERE q.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND q.idempotency_key = p.result_ref AND q.is_deleted = 0
                                     ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}} > 0
           AND p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'SCR|{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS sc_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(a2.id AS CHAR), 'no', a2.adjustment_no, 'job', CAST(a2.sa_v2_job_id AS CHAR)) AS CHAR)
          FROM stock_adjustment a2
         WHERE a2.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND a2.stock_count_id = IF({{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}} > 0, {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}},
                  COALESCE(g.stock_count_id, 0))
           AND a2.id <> {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}}
           AND a2.stock_adjustment_status = 'Processing' AND a2.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY a2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS fsc_processing_sa,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(fo.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', fo.job_status, 'correlation_id', fo.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', fo.progress_percent, 'progress_message', fo.progress_message,
                   'error_code', fo.error_code, 'error_message', fo.error_message, 'line_count', fo.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(fo.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fo.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'sa_no', IF(JSON_VALID(fo.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fo.request_payload, '$.saNo')), NULL),
                   'sc_id', IF(JSON_VALID(fo.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fo.request_payload, '$.scId')), NULL))) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job fo
         WHERE IF({{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}} > 0, {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}},
                  COALESCE(g.stock_count_id, 0)) > 0
           AND fo.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND fo.is_deleted = 0 AND fo.command = 'COMPLETE_SA'
           AND fo.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_SA', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
           AND JSON_VALID(fo.request_payload)
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fo.request_payload, '$.source')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = 'REVIEW'
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fo.request_payload, '$.scId')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
               = (CAST(IF({{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}} > 0, {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}},
                  COALESCE(g.stock_count_id, 0)) AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)) AS fsc_open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('step', p.step_name, 'ref', p.result_ref,
                            'young', (p.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 120 SECOND),
                            'job', (SELECT q.job_status FROM gd_async_job q
                                     WHERE q.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND q.idempotency_key = p.result_ref AND q.is_deleted = 0
                                     ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE IF({{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}} > 0, {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}},
                  COALESCE(g.stock_count_id, 0)) > 0
           AND p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = (CONCAT('SCR|', CAST(IF({{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}} > 0, {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.formScId}},
                  COALESCE(g.stock_count_id, 0)) AS CHAR)) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS fsc_lock
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN stock_adjustment g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.saId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN stock_count c
    ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND c.id = {{node:code_node_SSguard.data.scId}}
   AND c.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('t', x.t, 'm', CAST(x.m AS CHAR), 'b', CAST(x.b AS CHAR), 'p', CAST(x.p AS CHAR), 'n', x.n) AS j
  FROM (SELECT 'W' AS t, w.material_id AS m, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0) AS b, w.plant_id AS p, COUNT(*) AS n
          FROM wa_costing_method w
         WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND w.is_deleted = 0
           AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
           AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
           AND COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0) IN ({{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.batchIdsSql}})
         GROUP BY w.material_id, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0), w.plant_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'A' AS t, w.material_id AS m, 0 AS b, w.plant_id AS p, COUNT(*) AS n
          FROM wa_costing_method w
         WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND w.is_deleted = 0
           AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
           AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
         GROUP BY w.material_id, w.plant_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'F' AS t, f.material_id AS m, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0) AS b, f.plant_id AS p, COUNT(*) AS n
          FROM fifo_costing_history f
         WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND f.is_deleted = 0
           AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
           AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
           AND COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0) IN ({{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.batchIdsSql}})
         GROUP BY f.material_id, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0), f.plant_id) x

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'material_code', i.material_code, 'material_name', i.material_name,
       'item_batch_management', i.item_batch_management, 'material_costing_method', i.material_costing_method,
       'purchase_unit_price', CAST(i.purchase_unit_price AS CHAR),
       'table_uom_conversion', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(u.id AS CHAR), 'alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR),
                                       'base_uom_id', CAST(u.base_uom_id AS CHAR), 'alt_qty', CAST(u.alt_qty AS CHAR),
                                       'base_qty', CAST(u.base_qty AS CHAR)))
                                  FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
                                 WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                   AND u.item_id = i.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('src', c.src, 'material_id', CAST(c.material_id AS CHAR), 'plant_id', CAST(c.plant_id AS CHAR),
       'batch_id', CAST(c.batch_id AS CHAR), 'cost', CAST(c.cost AS CHAR), 'rn', CAST(c.rn AS CHAR), 'rn_any', CAST(c.rn_any AS CHAR)) AS j
FROM (
  SELECT 'WA' AS src, w.material_id, w.plant_id, w.batch_id, w.wa_cost_price AS cost,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.material_id, w.plant_id, w.batch_id
                            ORDER BY w.create_time DESC, w.id DESC) AS rn,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.material_id, w.plant_id
                            ORDER BY w.create_time DESC, w.id DESC) AS rn_any
  FROM wa_costing_method w
  WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.rvMatSql}})
    AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
    AND w.wa_cost_price > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIFO', f.material_id, f.plant_id, f.batch_id, f.fifo_cost_price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.material_id, f.plant_id, f.batch_id
                            ORDER BY CAST(f.fifo_sequence AS UNSIGNED) DESC, f.id DESC),
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.material_id, f.plant_id
                            ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC)
  FROM fifo_costing_history f
  WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.rvMatSql}})
    AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SSkeys.data.organizationId}}'
    AND f.fifo_cost_price > 0
) c
WHERE c.rn = 1 OR c.rn_any = 1
ORDER BY c.src, c.material_id, c.plant_id, c.batch_id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS job_id, j.job_status, j.correlation_id,
       g.stock_adjustment_status, g.adjustment_no, CAST(g.sa_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS sa_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id
           AND p.job_id = CONCAT('SAC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4))
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM gd_publish_step q
         WHERE q.tenant_id = j.tenant_id
           AND q.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND q.step_name LIKE 'S|%' AND q.is_deleted = 0) AS parts
  FROM gd_async_job j
  LEFT JOIN stock_adjustment g
    ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id
   AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^SA[|][0-9]{1,20}$'
   AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED)
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_SSguard.data.key}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1
